column1: # What enforces each requirement in this library's specs (0024-spec-format FR-011 - FR-014).
# mechanism: check | gate | review | none. by: "<repo>: <command>" for check and gate, the defining requirement for review, "-" for none.

column4: note
library.test.ts: the folder, the manifest, the package and the spec kit agree
package.test.ts: the entries a configuration imports are exported by name
package.test.ts: the launcher runs build and check on a fixture and finds the configuration upward
pack.test.ts: the package is packed with compiled modules, theme files, a launcher, a LICENSE and no link dependency
consumer.test.ts: the packed package installed into an empty project builds and checks a small repository
consumer.test.ts: a repository at another address has links to that address and names no other host

book.test.ts: the presentations are web, markdown, data and book, the site is what is written without a choice, and a book needs its volumes; the command line takes --presentation (one or several, by name) and --check for build, and refuses them for check; the files of a presentation are written, a book into a folder that holds other things leaves them, and a file that is not what a build writes is found; build --presentation book without a volume is refused, and the book is written and checked from the command line

book.test.ts: text that AsciiDoc would read as markup is passed through, a line that would be a list or a title begins safely, and a bracket is an attribute; every block is written: headings with anchors, lists, tables, code, callouts, entries, tabs, diagrams, cards and trees; a link to a page of the volume is a cross reference, to another is a link to the site where the book names one and its text where it does not; a volume is its parts' pages in the order of the navigation: a page is a chapter, a page under it a section, a page once, a part of each group, and a part that takes nothing is found; the files of a presentation are written, a book into a folder that holds other things leaves them, and a file that is not what a build writes is found

evidence.test.ts: CTRF is read into tests with their requirements, a file that is not CTRF or not JSON is said so, and tickets of GitHub are read without pull requests and are tied to a library and requirements by label, path and words; evidence.test.ts: a configuration's evidence is checked, and a folder that is missing is no run, and a file that cannot be read is a finding

evidence.test.ts: with a run recorded, the site has the Quality section, a line on each requirement, library and module, a finding for a test of a requirement that is not there, and the numbers in quality.json; evidence.test.ts: with no run recorded, no requirement is shown as passing, the pages say so, and a build with no evidence configured has no Quality section

evidence.test.ts: with a run recorded, the site has the Quality section, a line on each requirement, library and module, a finding for a test of a requirement that is not there, and the numbers in quality.json; evidence.test.ts: with no run recorded, no requirement is shown as passing, the pages say so, and a build with no evidence configured has no Quality section; evidence.test.ts: the runs of the workflows are read from runs.json, and the Workflows page says how each ended, the last runs as marks, how long a run takes, which jobs failed, and what flaps; evidence.test.ts: the dashboard says which build this is and how the generator's own check ended, and a library with no report says why from what its job says; evidence.test.ts: the findings page says what the generator found while it made the site, by library, and that it found nothing where it did
evidence.test.ts: the evidence tool runs a library's suite into CTRF the site reads, leaves meta.json, and refuses a library with no suite

evidence.test.ts: the runs of the workflows are read from runs.json, and the Workflows page says how each ended, the last runs as marks, how long a run takes, which jobs failed, and what flaps; evidence.test.ts: the tool that reads the runs writes a file that says so where the API cannot be reached, and the emergency page is made from the evidence alone
evidence.test.ts: the tool that reads the runs writes a file that says so where the API cannot be reached, and the emergency page is made from the evidence alone
evidence.test.ts: a configuration's problems and a lens that throws are findings and the site is made without them

evidence.test.ts: the history says how a library's tests moved over its runs: what began to fail, what was fixed, what keeps failing and what flaps, with trends, causes and the range of commits; evidence.test.ts: the history tool adds a run once, keeps the newest, and refuses evidence with no time
evidence.test.ts: each library is held to the gate of the configuration, shown and enforced nowhere, and the requirements page says how each specification stands
check.test.ts: the site of commons builds with no finding, the same twice, with its sections, the Quality section and the issues of data
check.test.ts: the site of commons builds with no finding, the same twice, with its sections, the Quality section and the issues of data

evidence.test.ts: the log of git is read into commits, the bus factor is how few authors made half of the commits, a file's last change is its newest commit, and a repository with no history is said to have none
check.test.ts: the site of commons builds with no finding, the same twice, with its sections, the Quality section and the issues of data
evidence.test.ts: line coverage is read from the lcov of bun, left to the library's source files, shown as a percent on the dashboard and as the least covered files on the library's page

evidence.test.ts: the four measures of DORA are taken from the runs of the publishing workflow: publishes a day, the median minutes of a successful run, the share of runs that failed and the minutes from a failure to the next pass, and fewer than two runs give none
highlight.test.ts: SQL is coloured by the lexer of the SQL language library

evidence.test.ts: the tests that exercise an export are those of its package whose files import it, by the name it is exported under, and the API page of an export says how many there are and whether any fails
evidence.test.ts: the open issues and tickets that name a file are on the page of the file, with a badge, and an issue's file evidence links back to the page of the file

evidence.test.ts: the report of Stryker is read into the mutants killed, surviving and not run of each source file, the score is the share the tests detected, and the dashboard, the library's page and the file's API page show it
evidence.test.ts: the changes since the tests ran are read from git's name-status, each path is source, test, specification or other, and with no history the page says so

repo-ops.test.ts: the lens makes the Repo Ops pages from guides and typed facts, a page that cannot be read is a finding, and commons' site has the section with the workflows and every verb of repoctl
findings.test.ts: the page, the counts, the accepted risks, the exports and the banner, from findings kept as the workflows write them
evidence.test.ts: the package page shows the report against its budget, by kind and by library, the peers and each consumer, a file that is no report is a finding, and no report says how to make one

release.test.ts: the newest stable version of the registry is the heading, title and footer of every page; without a registry the package.json is shown as unconfirmed; the badge counts commits since the record; an unreadable registry is a finding

packaging-page.test.ts: the page of the packaging has the strategy, the versions, the budget, the kinds, the largest libraries and the peers from the evidence, and shows no trend and nothing measured without a report

look.test.ts: the stylesheets and the script ask for nothing of another host, no Fumadocs or Tailwind package is a dependency, the fonts are files of the site with their licenses beside them, NOTICE carries the license of Fumadocs and the notices list the fonts, the theme and the icons

look.test.ts: the reading area is white and the dark is the reference's, every token pair that carries text has a contrast of 4.5 to 1 in both themes, every class of a page has its rule in the stylesheet, and the stylesheet is the one the tool made (its digest and the versions are in the provenance file)

look.test.ts: the page has the reference's layout (the grid, the side navigation with the name, the version and the selector of sections, the panel, the article of 760 pixels beside the outline of 304, the trail, the previous and the next page) and no width of 1400

look.test.ts: the components are the reference's markup (callouts of its three colours, tabs, cards, code with a title bar or a corner button, a table in its wrapper, a file tree), and the reduced motion, the visible focus and the print style that leaves out the chrome are held
workflow.test.ts: the workflow site keeps registry.json and package.report.json with steps that end green and leave a finding

look.test.ts: the width button is drawn like the theme's with an accessible name and its state, the cookie is named, scoped, kept a year and read by the head's script before the page is drawn, each part is guarded, and the stylesheet has the full width
look.test.ts: the provenance file records the packages, the live pages and the day they were read, the departures and the blocks with no component in the reference
look.test.ts: the record of the measurements against the reference covers the regions, the widths and the themes and explains each difference (the measuring itself is made by hand with a browser)
grouping.test.ts: the libraries are listed by family and group, the host first, a library of neither is not listed, and the title of a family is its host's
grouping.test.ts: a family is one folder with its extensions beneath under short names, a group of no host has a page, and in the real site no two libraries of one family are flat siblings

mizan-guides.test.ts: the group Mizan holds the overview and sixteen pages in order with every link resolved, the diagrams are Mermaid, the explanation is not shorter than its source was, and the root has no MIZAN.html

kanon-guides.test.ts: the group Kanon holds the overview and twelve pages in order with every link resolved, nine diagrams or more, each quoted block equal to its source lines, each output block with a command and a day, and no long dash
ci-timing.test.ts: the median and the 90th percentile, the slowest jobs and steps, and a workflow over its target as a finding
evidence-shards.test.ts: the evidence job runs the tests once with the coverage, in the shards of CI, and the repository's tests in 3 cells
evidence-shards.test.ts: the shards put together equal the evidence of one run of the whole suite
evidence-shards.test.ts: the mutation job keeps Stryker's incremental file between nights; run twice on a library the second run keeps the first's result
